notes: Text and JSON values/keys were recursively processed by the shared sanitizer.
Structural omissions remove generated event, response, call, signature, and cost metadata only; record content, errors, tool results, timestamps, model identifiers, usage fields, and order remain.
Home-directory listings, local paths/file URLs, internal addresses, credentials, opaque payloads, and embedded images are represented by stable markers or omitted as counted above.
The public session intentionally contains no source absolute path, private mapping, response/call identifier, signature, or cost value.
